blurb: Bonny Doon Vineyard focuses on producing wines expressive of place, using indigenous yeast and minimal intervention winemaking techniques. They offer a range of wines including Sauvignon Blanc, Cabernet Sauvignon blends, and their flagship Cigare wines. The winery emphasizes terroir-driven wines with moderate alcohol and minimal new oak usage.
